csv_project_name: Engineering for Boomerang Park Nature Trail Project
csv_scope_of_work: The project consists of professional landscape architectural and civil engineering design services for the Boomerang Park Nature Trail located at 699 Avenue C, Haines City, FL 33844. The selected firm will manage the project from initiation, data collection, and site analysis through final development. It is the intended goal to create a safe, accessible, and aesthetically pleasing recreational amenity that complements existing park facilities and the natural environment. Design responsibilities shall include, but not be limited to, trail alignments, grading, drainage, stormwater management, and erosion control measures. The scope also includes associated site improvements such as pedestrian connectivity, native landscaping, strategic lighting, seating areas, wayfinding signage, and irrigation implementation. The consultant should maintain active project management and coordination with the City to ensure compliance with local, state, and federal requirements. Ultimately delivering Environmental Resources Permitting, data collection, and signed and sealed construction drawings ready for permitting, bidding, and construction.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Sanitation Engineering, Stormwater, Graphic Design/Public Art
